chunks: I have come to know such a thing about you that if you have done so then you have displeased your Lord, disobeyed your Imām and betrayed your trust.
ai.seo_question: What are the three spiritual and administrative consequences of an officer's misconduct according to Imam Ali in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: This epistle exemplifies the tripartite structure of authority in Shia political thought, linking divine obedience (Rabb), prophetic succession (Imam), and administrative integrity (Amanah). Sharif al-Radi’s compilation highlights how Ali (AS) used this concise warning to reinforce the concept of *Wilayah* as both a spiritual and administrative duty, where failure in governance is viewed as a breach of trust before God and the Imam.
